Власть принадлежит выборным представител: Power rests with elected representatives. Guarantees high internal stability and gives bonuses to diplomacy, but the bureaucratic apparatus slows down the adoption of emergency decisions.
Наследная власть аристократии. Обеспечив: Hereditary power of the aristocracy. Provides unshakable legitimacy and elite cohesion, but carries a constant risk of technological and social stagnation due to the conservatism of the court.
A state forged in the crucible of war. Focused on dominance, it gives powerful bonuses to military strength and expansion speed, but requires enormous costs for managing territories.
Теневое правление элитарного меньшинства: Shadow rule by an elite minority. Stimulates rapid economic growth and concentration of capital, paying for it with monstrous social inequality and the risk of riots.
Абсолютная власть одного лидера, опирающ: Absolute power of one leader, based on the security apparatus. It allows you to instantly mobilize society, but is based solely on fear, making stability extremely fragile.
Государство, ведомое божественным культо: A state led by a divine cult. Provides fanatical unity and unbending morale in armies, but blind faith seriously inhibits freedom of thought and scientific progress.
Власть холодного разума и научного метод: The power of cold reason and the scientific method. Significantly accelerates technological breakthroughs and optimizes efficiency, but completely ignores the human factor and social needs.
Государство как гигантский бизнес-синдик: The state as a giant business syndicate. Opens up unlimited opportunities for trade and super-profits, but turns citizens into a resource with minimal loyalty to the regime.
Единая воля, управляющая миллиардами тел: A single will that controls billions of drone bodies. Demonstrates absolute coordination and a complete absence of internal conflicts, forever erasing the concept of individuality.
Синтетический интеллект. Фракция классиф: Synthetic intelligence. The faction is classified as robots: all planets are considered native, infantry is produced at the Military Factory (×3), 2 research and 2 captures per cycle are available. Cold logic imposes a penalty on basic income.
Общество, построенное на принципах всеоб: A society built on the principles of universal suffrage and freedoms. Provides a high level of happiness and loyalty of the population, but democratic procedures critically slow down the transition of the economy to a war footing.
Режим, провозглашающий абсолютное равенс: A regime that proclaims absolute equality of rights and opportunities. Guarantees unprecedented cohesion of society, but the lack of privileges deprives the state of bonuses from the formation of strong elites.
Система, где статус и власть даются искл: A system where status and power are given solely for outstanding ability. Creates extremely competent leadership, stimulating a constant flow of talent and rapid growth of scientific research.
Устройство, при котором политическое вли: A device in which political influence is directly proportional to the amount of capital. Maximizes economic benefit, but condemns the lower classes to poverty, forcing the state to balance on the brink of class protests.
Государство, контролируемое закрытым син: A state controlled by a closed syndicate of influential individuals. It ensures monolithic stability of the ruling elite, but inevitably gives rise to large-scale corruption in the lower echelons of power.
Режим строгой вертикали власти, жестко к: A regime of strict vertical power, tightly controlling key aspects of life. Guarantees iron order and high discipline in the army, paying for this by suppressing civil initiatives.
Система абсолютного надзора за каждым ша: A system of absolute supervision over every step and thought of a citizen. Allows you to achieve peak efficiency during total military mobilization, reducing the concept of personal happiness to the level of statistical error.
Тирания, опирающаяся на террор и непрере: Tyranny based on terror and the unquestioned authority of the ruler. Decisions are carried out instantly and unquestioningly, but the regime is based only on fear, which makes the risk of bloody riots permanent.
Крайняя форма диктатуры. Государство выж: An extreme form of dictatorship. The state squeezes everything out of the planets through extortion and forced labor, relying on the secret police to speed up production and income. The downside of such oppression is a sharp rise in the cost of science and stagnation of thought.
Децентрализованная сеть самоуправляемых: A decentralized network of self-governing communities without a coercive apparatus. Gives society incredible flexibility and absolute freedom, but the lack of structure results in chaos and the inability to maintain a regular army.
Развивающийся рубеж на границе изведанно: An evolving frontier on the edge of known space, existing under the protectorate of the Foundation. Isolation from the central worlds results in a shortage of starting resources, but it grants unprecedented freedom of development and powerful acceleration of expansion. The basic infrastructure includes a ready-made Special Services Center.
Состоявшееся планетарное государство с у: An established planetary state with established logistics. It rests on a solid economic foundation and high production potential, for which it has to pay with heavy administrative and financial obligations. Basic infrastructure includes a ready-made Civil Factory.
Наиболее адаптивный вид в галактике. Отл: The most adaptive species in the galaxy. They are distinguished by high evolutionary plasticity to any conditions and a balanced approach to survival. They do not have pronounced vulnerabilities, but they also lack highly specialized natural advantages.
Социально ориентированные виды с сильным: Socially oriented species with strong pack instincts. Their amazing natural vitality and ability to reproduce provide the state with a stable demographic explosion and accelerated settlement of new colonies.
Хладнокровные хищники с прочной чешуей и: Cold-blooded predators with durable scales and innate killer instincts. Their aggression and physical endurance form the ideal basis for an indestructible army, but their slow metabolism and low reproduction rate make every loss on the front extremely noticeable.
Эволюционировавшие покорители небес с по: Evolved sky conquerors with hollow bones and incredible reaction speed. Their unique spatial intelligence gives the fleet unrivaled maneuverability, and intelligence - absolute superiority in the collection of tactical data.
Существа, объединенные химической связью: Creatures united by a chemical bond or a rigid hive hierarchy. They provide colossal production volumes and inexhaustible human resources, where an individual is only a consumable material in the name of the prosperity of the Swarm.
Обитатели глубин, чья физиология неразры: Inhabitants of the depths, whose physiology is inextricably linked with the hydrosphere. They demonstrate the highest efficiency in the colonization of oceanic planets, but face critical difficulties in logistics and combat on arid worlds.
Симбиотические формы жизни, способные к: Symbiotic life forms capable of photosynthesis and deep integration with the biosphere of planets. They guarantee the state absolute food independence, while being characterized by extremely low mobility and a leisurely pace of expansion.
Кремниевые формы жизни, буквально высече: Silicon life forms literally carved from solid rock. They consume minerals instead of organic food and are able to survive in a vacuum without spacesuits. Their monumental strength is compensated by the catastrophically long cycle of formation of new individuals.
Искусственно созданные или радикально ау: Artificially created or radically augmented mechanisms. They play by their own rules: any world is home (terraforms are not needed), 2 explorations and 2 captures per cycle, infantry comes from Military Factories (×3), ground vehicles are 35% cheaper, logistics drones give +50% to warehouses and +10% to production. They do not consume goods and do not know the social sphere: hunger and riots are indifferent to them, but they cannot disperse their income with prosperity - they will lose 1.00 forever. The population is not born, but gathered: growth comes from INDUSTRY, not social security. Payment for synthetic nature - energy consumption: −15% of income.
Эфемерные создания, сотканные из полей ч: Ephemeral creatures woven from fields of pure energy. They have frightening, exotic combat power that violates the usual laws of physics, but are critically vulnerable to specialized electromagnetic weapons and jammers.
Бескомпромиссная вера в силу разума и на: An uncompromising belief in the power of reason and the scientific method. Society is subordinated to a single goal - technological superiority, which provides an unprecedented leap in research due to a complete disregard for outdated ethical standards.
Государство, возведшее войну в ранг высш: A state that has elevated war to the rank of the highest virtue. The entire economy, culture and industry work towards the constant modernization of the army and navy, turning the faction into an ideal military machine.
Категорическое отрицание агрессии как сп: Categorical denial of aggression as a way to resolve conflicts. It guarantees economic prosperity and the highest level of happiness for citizens, but makes the state critically vulnerable to a direct military threat.
Неутолимая жажда новых территорий и ресу: An unquenchable thirst for new territories and resources. The doctrine of continuous expansion of borders significantly reduces the cost of establishing colonies and capturing new star systems, turning expansion into a matter of survival.
Доктрина абсолютной самодостаточности и: The doctrine of absolute self-sufficiency and deep distrust of strangers. Provides monolithic internal stability and impregnable defense of borders, but almost completely paralyzes any diplomatic contacts.
Искреннее уважение к многообразию галакт: Sincere respect for the diversity of galactic life forms. Opens up the broadest prospects for interstellar trade and building strong diplomatic alliances, erasing cultural and biological barriers.
Фанатичная уверенность в абсолютном прев: Fanatical confidence in the absolute superiority of one's own species. Radically increases combat effectiveness in wars to destroy aliens, but makes diplomacy and the search for allies almost impossible.
Поиск высшего смысла за пределами матери: Search for higher meaning beyond the material world. Fundamental faith gives the people unshakable internal unity and a fanatical fighting spirit, before which even the animal fear of death recedes.
Стремление превзойти биологические огран: The desire to exceed biological limitations at any cost. Mass augmentation and genetic engineering are accelerating scientific progress and creating soldiers whose combat capabilities are far beyond natural capabilities.
Философия абсолютного симбиоза с биосфер: The philosophy of absolute symbiosis with the biosphere. Allows the extraction of maximum renewable resources from colonized worlds, while severely limiting the deployment of destructive heavy industry.
Безжалостная эксплуатация материи ради б: Ruthless exploitation of matter for the sake of endless growth of production. Guarantees the colossal capacity of industrial factories, irrevocably turning once flourishing worlds into dead, toxic wastelands.

«Классическая Эра» — независимый авторск: “Classical Era” is an independent author’s text role-playing project (RTRP) with its own timeline, lore and rules. The project does not rely on third-party canons (Star Wars, Warhammer, Mass Effect, etc.) and is non-commercial. Our goal is to bring back the atmosphere of the “old format” role-playing game: light, creative and emotional.
